experiments.name: Selective sharing overhead
experiments.metric: ms (filtered read avg − full read avg, both grant-based)
experiments.detail: n=20 each; full grant-based read avg=1.912ms, Protocol-filtered read avg=1.457ms (both non-self, so neither pays the accessPolicy computation cost — isolates pure field-filtering overhead)

experiments.name: Access revocation time
experiments.detail: revokeAccess call latency; subsequent read returned 403 (expected 403)

experiments.name: Key recovery success rate
experiments.detail: 10/10 valid-threshold reconstructions matched original; 10/10 insufficient-share attempts correctly threw

experiments.name: VC verification time
experiments.detail: Proof verification did not complete within 20s

experiments.name: Selective disclosure payload reduction
experiments.detail: Selective proof (3 attrs + age predicate): 19508 bytes. Full-reveal proof (all 8 attrs): 6193 bytes. Real AnonCreds presentations fetched via /proof-data.

experiments.name: Selective disclosure latency cost
experiments.detail: Selective request→verified: 5630.0ms. Full-reveal request→verified: 5574.4ms. Positive value = selective disclosure cost more.

experiments.name: Selective disclosure payload reduction (attribute count only, no predicate)
experiments.detail: Selective proof, no predicate (3 attrs only): 6148 bytes. Full-reveal proof (all 8 attrs): 6193 bytes. Isolates attribute-count reduction from predicate cost.

experiments.name: Selective disclosure latency cost (attribute count only, no predicate)
experiments.detail: Selective (no predicate) request→verified: 6563.2ms. Full-reveal request→verified: 5574.4ms. Positive value = selective disclosure cost more.

experiments.name: Concurrent credential workflow scalability
experiments.detail: Highest concurrency level with 0 failures and avg <1000ms: none. Set up 3/3 real connections+credentials. Per-level (real, uncapped latency, 90000ms timeout): 2: avg 6089.4ms, p95 6594.6ms | 3: avg 8931ms, p95 11619.6ms
